results.title: REDCap: Your Complete Solution for Online Databases and Surveys for Research | OHSU
results.content: ### REDCap for research. The Standard Support track is designed to offer the broadest use of and support for REDCap, by making available help from the REDCap team and use of the full REDCap feature set, in exchange for the persons building and managing a project completing the required training(s). The Self-Service Support track is designed to streamline the process of setting up and managing a simple REDCap project by eliminating the REDCap training and testing requirement as conditions for getting started and launching a project to production, in exchange for limiting the use of REDCap to features and functionality that don't require the REDCap Team's assistance for implementation, guidance or review for utilization or ensuring compliance. For research projects, there is no cost for support and help activities for the core functionality that's covered in our Basics and Survey trainings. Although REDCap's primary and intended use is for research data collection, REDCap can be used for the following kinds of non-research data collection projects at OHSU:.
